title: Webinar this week on the new CMDGA resource
summary: The Diabetes Epigenome Atlas is now the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas (CMDGA; cmdga.org)!
bodyHtml:
The Diabetes Epigenome Atlas is now the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas (CMDGA; cmdga.org)! CMDGA has new data types relevant to multiple diseases in addition to diabetes, and offers beautiful new visualizations for gene expression and single-cell epigenomic data. Find out about this expanded and updated resource in this week's webinar.

Thursday, September 23
12-1 PM US Eastern time
